guestCheckout.q: Do I need an account to place an order?
guestCheckout.a: No! We support guest checkout — simply enter your contact info and shipping address at checkout. However, creating an account lets you track your order history and save your addresses for faster future checkouts.

shippingTime.a: We process orders within 1–2 business days. After that, estimated delivery is 3–7 business days depending on your location. USPS Priority Mail typically takes 1–3 days; USPS Ground Advantage 2–5 days; UPS Ground 1–5 days.

shippingCost.a: Shipping costs are calculated at checkout based on the total weight of your order and your delivery address. You'll see the exact rate before entering payment information — no surprises.

authentic.q: Are your products authentic Indonesian brands?
authentic.a: Absolutely. All products we carry are genuine, original Indonesian brands — the same ones you'd find at a supermarket in Indonesia. We do not sell counterfeit or knock-off products.

paymentMethods.q: What payment methods do you accept?
paymentMethods.a: We accept all major credit and debit cards: Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and Discover. Payments are processed securely through Stripe — your card information is never stored on our servers.

About.heading: About Warung IndoMi
About.subheading: Your trusted source for authentic Indonesian groceries, delivered across the USA.

ourStory.heading: Bringing a Taste of Home to Every Corner of America
ourStory.paragraph1: Warung IndoMi was born out of a simple, deeply felt need: the longing for the flavors of home. For the Indonesian diaspora scattered across the United States, finding authentic Indonesian products — the same brands you grew up with, the same tastes that remind you of your mother's cooking, your favorite street snack, the cup of kopi tubruk on a quiet morning — has always been a challenge.
ourStory.paragraph2: We are based in <location>Madison Heights, Michigan</location>, and we serve Indonesian communities across all 50 US states. What started as a way to meet local demand has grown into a mission: to make authentic Indonesian groceries accessible to every Indonesian in America, no matter where they live.
ourStory.paragraph3: We hand-select every product we carry — prioritizing genuine brands, checking freshness, and packing every order with care. When you order from us, you're not just buying groceries. You're getting a piece of home, shipped directly to your door.

products.title: 366+ Authentic Products
products.desc: Carefully curated selection of genuine Indonesian brands across 12 categories — from Indomie to ABC to Kecap Bango.

shipping.title: Nationwide Shipping

guestCheckout.q: Do I need an account to place an order?
guestCheckout.a: No! We support guest checkout — simply enter your contact info and shipping address at checkout. However, creating an account lets you track your order history and save your shipping addresses for faster future checkouts.

trackOrder.q: How do I track my order?
trackOrder.a: Once your order ships, we'll send a tracking number to your email. You can also view your tracking status on the USPS or UPS website. If you have an account, your orders are also visible under "My Orders."

modifyOrder.q: Can I modify or cancel my order after placing it?
modifyOrder.a: We process orders quickly, but if you need to make changes, please contact us via WhatsApp (+1 626 461-4963) as soon as possible. Once an order has been shipped (status: Shipped), it can no longer be cancelled or modified.

orderStatuses.q: What does each order status mean?

noConfirmationEmail.q: I placed an order but didn't receive a confirmation email. What should I do?
noConfirmationEmail.a: Please check your spam or junk folder first. If the email is not there, contact us via WhatsApp with your name and the email address you used to place the order.

shippingTime.a: We process orders within 1–2 business days. After that, estimated delivery is 3–7 business days depending on your location and the carrier chosen. USPS Priority Mail typically takes 1–3 days; USPS Ground Advantage 2–5 days; UPS Ground 1–5 days.

shippingCost.a: Shipping costs are calculated at checkout based on the total weight of your order and your delivery address. You'll see the exact shipping rate before you enter payment information.

hawaiiAlaska.q: Do you ship to all US states, including Hawaii and Alaska?
hawaiiAlaska.a: Yes! We ship to all 50 US states. Please note that shipping to Hawaii and Alaska may cost more and take longer than the contiguous 48 states.

lostDamaged.q: What happens if my package is lost or damaged?
lostDamaged.a: Please contact us within 7 days of the expected delivery date. We'll file a carrier claim on your behalf and resolve the situation as quickly as possible. For damaged packages, please keep all original packaging and take photos.

authentic.q: Are your products authentic Indonesian brands?
authentic.a: Absolutely. All products we carry are genuine, original Indonesian brands — the same ones you'd find at a supermarket in Indonesia or trusted Asian grocery stores in the US. We do not sell counterfeit or knock-off products.

halal.a: Many of our products are halal-certified. Please check the product packaging or description for halal certification details. If you're unsure about a specific product, feel free to ask us via WhatsApp.

expiry.q: What are the expiry dates on products?
expiry.a: We regularly rotate our stock to ensure freshness. All products are sold with a minimum of 3 months before the expiry date. The exact expiry date is printed on each product's packaging.

requestProduct.q: Can I request a specific product you don't currently carry?
requestProduct.a: Yes! We love hearing from our customers. If there's a product you'd like us to stock, please let us know via WhatsApp. We do our best to source popular requests.

paymentMethods.q: What payment methods do you accept?
paymentMethods.a: We accept all major credit and debit cards: Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and Discover. Payments are processed securely through Stripe.

safeCard.q: Is it safe to enter my card details on your website?
safeCard.a: Yes. Your payment is processed by Stripe, a PCI DSS Level 1 certified payment processor. We never see or store your full card number — it goes directly to Stripe's secure servers.

whenCharged.a: Your card is charged immediately when you confirm your order at checkout. You'll receive an order confirmation email right after.

canReturn.a: Due to food safety regulations, most grocery and food items are non-returnable once received. However, if you received a damaged item or the wrong product, we will make it right. Please see our full Return & Refund Policy for details.

refundTime.q: How long does a refund take?
refundTime.a: Once we approve your refund, it is processed via Stripe back to your original payment method. This typically takes 5–10 business days to appear on your statement, depending on your bank or card issuer.

resetPassword.q: How do I reset my password?
resetPassword.a: Go to the Login page and click "Forgot Password?" Enter your email address and we'll send you a password reset link.

deleteAccount.q: How do I delete my account?
deleteAccount.a: To request account deletion, please contact us via WhatsApp (+1 626 461-4963) with the email address associated with your account. We'll process the deletion within 5 business days.

guestVsAccount.q: Can I use the same account for both ordering and as a guest?
guestVsAccount.a: Yes. If you placed a guest order and then create an account with the same email, your order history may not automatically link. Contact us and we can manually associate past orders with your account.

PrivacyPolicy.metaDescription: Learn how Warung IndoMi collects, uses, and protects your personal information when you shop on our website.
PrivacyPolicy.label: Legal
PrivacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPolicy.subtitle: How we collect, use, and protect your personal information.
PrivacyPolicy.intro: Warung IndoMi ("we," "our," or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website and place an order. Please read this policy carefully. By using our site, you agree to the practices described here.

s1.heading: 1. Information We Collect
s1.directInfoIntro: When you place an order or create an account, we collect:
directInfoList: Shipping address (street, city, state, ZIP code)
Password (if you create an account — stored securely via Firebase Auth, never in plain text)
Order notes or messages you send us
s1.paymentInfoBody: All payment processing is handled by Stripe, a PCI DSS Level 1 certified payment processor. We never see, receive, or store your full credit card number, CVV, or other sensitive payment data. Stripe may collect and store payment information in accordance with their own Privacy Policy.
s1.autoInfoIntro: When you visit our website, we may automatically collect:
autoInfoList: Pages viewed and time spent on the site
Session data stored in cookies (cart contents, login session)

s2.heading: 2. How We Use Your Information
s2.intro: We use the information we collect to:
list: Process and fulfill your orders
Send order confirmation and shipping notification emails
Generate shipping labels and coordinate delivery via USPS and UPS
Respond to your questions and provide customer support
Maintain and improve our website and services
Comply with legal obligations (tax records, fraud prevention)
Send promotional emails if you opt in (you can unsubscribe at any time)
s2.noSell: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information to third parties for their own marketing purposes.

s3.heading: 3. Third-Party Services
s3.intro: We use trusted third-party services to operate our business. Each has its own privacy policy:
s3.shippo: shipping label generation and rate calculation via USPS and UPS.
s3.resend: transactional email delivery (order confirmations, shipping notifications).
s3.supabase: secure cloud database where your order and account information is stored.

s4.heading: 4. Cookies
s4.intro: We use cookies to improve your experience on our site. We use only essential cookies:
s4.authCookieDesc: keeps you logged in during your session (via Firebase Auth)
s4.cartCookieDesc: saves your cart contents between page visits so items are not lost when you close the browser tab
s4.noThirdParty: We do not use third-party advertising or tracking cookies. You can disable cookies in your browser settings, but this may affect certain features of the site (e.g., staying logged in or keeping items in your cart).

s5.heading: 5. Data Retention
s5.orderRecordsDesc: retained for 7 years to comply with US tax and accounting regulations
s5.accountDataDesc: retained until you request deletion of your account
s5.guestDataDesc: email and shipping address retained alongside the order record for the same 7-year period
s5.deleteRequest: If you would like your personal data deleted, please contact us via WhatsApp or email. We will fulfill your request within 30 days, except for information we are legally required to retain.

s6.heading: 6. Your Rights (CCPA — California Residents)
s6.intro: If you are a California resident, the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) gives you specific rights regarding your personal information:
s6.rightToKnowDesc: you can request details about what personal data we have collected about you and how it is used
s6.rightToDeleteDesc: you can request that we delete your personal data, subject to certain exceptions
s6.rightToOptOutLabel: Right to Opt Out of Sale
s6.rightToOptOutDesc: we do not sell your personal data, so this right is not applicable, but we honor this principle
s6.rightToNonDiscriminationDesc: we will not discriminate against you for exercising any of your CCPA rights
s6.exerciseRights: To exercise these rights, contact us via WhatsApp at +1 (626) 461-4963. We will respond within 45 days.

s7.heading: 7. Children's Privacy (COPPA)
s7.body: Our website is not directed to children under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe we have inadvertently collected such information, please contact us immediately and we will take steps to delete it.

s8.heading: 8. Data Security
s8.intro: We take reasonable measures to protect your personal information, including:
list: HTTPS encryption on all pages
Payment processing via Stripe (PCI DSS compliant — we never store card data)
Secure cloud database (Supabase) with access controls
Firebase Auth for secure password management
s8.noGuarantee: No method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure. While we strive to protect your data, we cannot guarantee absolute security.

s9.heading: 9. Changes to This Policy
s9.body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Material changes will be communicated via email to registered users. The "Last updated" date at the top of this page indicates when the most recent changes were made. Continued use of our site after any changes constitutes your acceptance of the updated policy.

ReturnPolicy.metaDescription: Warung IndoMi return and refund policy — learn when refunds are issued, how to request one, and our policy on food and grocery items.
ReturnPolicy.label: Legal
ReturnPolicy.title: Return & Refund Policy
ReturnPolicy.subtitle: Your satisfaction matters to us. Here's everything you need to know.

s1.heading: Our Commitment
s1.body1: At Warung IndoMi, we take great care in packing and shipping every order. If something goes wrong, we want to make it right. Please read this policy carefully so you know what to expect and how to reach us if you have a problem.
s1.body2: All return and refund requests must be submitted within 7 calendar days of the delivery date shown in your tracking information.

s2.heading: Food & Grocery Items Are Non-Returnable
s2.intro: Due to food safety regulations and FDA guidelines, most food and grocery products cannot be returned once they have been delivered. This applies to:
list: Instant noodles (mie instan), rice, and other dry goods
Seasonings, spices, and cooking sauces (bumbu, sambal, kecap, saus)
Beverages and coffee
Snacks and crackers (kerupuk, snack kemasan)
Baking ingredients and dairy products
Health products, vitamins, and personal care items
Any product where the packaging seal has been broken or opened
s2.note: This is standard practice for food retailers in the United States and is required for consumer safety. We appreciate your understanding.

s3.heading: When We Will Issue a Refund
s3.intro: We will issue a full refund or replacement in the following situations:
s3.case1Intro: If your product arrived damaged (e.g., broken packaging, crushed boxes, leaking contents), please contact us with:
case1List: Clear photos of the damaged item(s)
Photos of the outer packaging (box or mailer)
s3.case2Body: If you received a product that is different from what you ordered, we will arrange a replacement or full refund. Please send us your order number and a photo of the item you received.
s3.case3Body: If your order arrived but one or more items were missing, contact us with your order number and a photo of the items you did receive. We will verify against our packing records and resolve the issue.
s3.case4Body: If your tracking shows "delivered" but you did not receive the package, please first check with neighbors and around your property. Then contact us and we will file a missing package claim with the carrier on your behalf.

s4.heading: How to Request a Refund
s4.intro: To submit a refund request, follow these steps:
s4.step1Body: Take clear photos of the issue (damaged product, wrong item, or the outer packaging)
s4.step2BodyAfter: within 7 days of receiving your order
s4.step3Body: Include your order number (format: WIM-YEAR-XXXX) and photos
s4.step4Body: Our team will review your request and respond within 1–2 business days

s5.heading: Refund Processing Time
s5.intro: Once your refund is approved, it will be processed through Stripe back to your original payment method. Please allow:
list: 1–3 business days for us to process and submit the refund through Stripe
5–10 additional business days for the refund to appear on your bank or credit card statement (this timeline is set by your bank, not us)
s5.note: You will receive an email confirmation when the refund is processed. We are unable to accelerate the timeline on your bank's end.

s6.heading: Order Cancellations
s6.intro: You may request a cancellation before your order is shipped. Since we process orders quickly (typically within 1–2 business days), please contact us as soon as possible if you need to cancel.
s6.pendingItem: Orders with status Pending or Processing — can be cancelled for a full refund
s6.shippedItem: Orders with status Shipped — cannot be cancelled. If you still want a refund, the item must qualify under the conditions above

s7.heading: Exceptions & Non-Refundable Situations
s7.intro: Refunds will not be issued for:
list: Products returned without prior authorization — please always contact us first before sending anything back
Damage caused by improper storage after delivery (e.g., heat exposure, moisture)
Products opened or partially consumed, unless defective upon opening
Incorrect shipping address provided by the customer resulting in a failed delivery
Carrier delays outside our control (weather events, holidays, USPS/UPS service disruptions)
Requests submitted more than 7 days after delivery
Change of mind after the order has been shipped

ShippingPolicy.metaDescription: Warung IndoMi shipping policy — carriers, delivery times, shipping rates, coverage area, tracking, and how we handle lost or damaged packages.
ShippingPolicy.label: Shipping
ShippingPolicy.title: Shipping Policy
ShippingPolicy.subtitle: Everything you need to know about how we ship your order.
ShippingPolicy.intro: We want your Indonesian grocery haul to arrive safely and on time. Below is everything you need to know about how we pack and ship orders, delivery timeframes, and what to do if something goes wrong.

s1.heading: Shipping Carriers
s1.intro: We ship via two major US carriers:
s1.usps: USPS (United States Postal Service) — Priority Mail (1–3 days) and Ground Advantage (2–5 days)
s1.ups: UPS (United Parcel Service) — UPS Ground (1–5 days depending on zone)
s1.note: The carrier and service level are selected automatically based on the weight and dimensions of your order and your delivery address. We use Shippo to generate shipping labels and calculate the best available rates.

s2.heading: Processing Time
s2.intro: Orders are processed on business days (Monday–Friday), excluding federal holidays. After successful payment:
s2.item1: Most orders are packed and shipped within 1–2 business days
s2.item2: Orders placed before 2:00 PM Eastern Time (ET) on a business day are typically shipped the same day or next business day
s2.item3: During peak seasons (e.g., holidays, Eid/Lebaran), processing may take an additional 1–2 days

s3.heading: Estimated Delivery Times
s3.intro: Delivery times below are estimates from the ship date (not the order date) and apply to orders shipped from Madison Heights, Michigan.
s3.ups: UPS Ground: 1–5 business days (shorter for nearby states)
s3.note: Estimated delivery times are not guarantees. Carriers occasionally experience delays due to weather, volume surges, or other factors outside our control. We are not liable for delays caused by carrier issues once the package has been handed off.

s4.heading: Shipping Rates
s4.intro: Shipping costs are calculated in real time at checkout based on:
list: Total weight of your order
Package dimensions (we use standard box presets)
Your delivery zip code
s4.note: You will see the exact shipping cost and can choose your preferred carrier and service level before you enter payment information. There are no hidden shipping fees.

s5.heading: Shipping Coverage
s5.usStatesBody: We ship to all 50 US states, including Hawaii and Alaska. Deliveries to Hawaii and Alaska may have higher shipping costs and longer estimated delivery times.
s5.poBoxBody: USPS can deliver to PO Boxes. UPS cannot deliver to PO Boxes. If you provide a PO Box address, your order will automatically be shipped via USPS.
s5.internationalBody: We currently do not ship internationally. We only ship within the United States. We also do not ship to US territories such as Puerto Rico, Guam, US Virgin Islands, or APO/FPO military addresses at this time.

s6.heading: Package Tracking
s6.intro: Once your order ships, you will receive a shipping confirmation email with:
list: Your tracking number
A link to track your package directly on USPS.com or UPS.com
Estimated delivery date (if available from the carrier)
s6.orderHistoryNote: If you have an account, you can also track your order status from your <link>Order History</link> page.
s6.delayNote: Please allow 24 hours after receiving your tracking email for the tracking information to be updated in the carrier's system.

s7.heading: Lost or Damaged Packages
s7.notDeliveredIntro: If your tracking shows "Delivered" but you have not received your package:
s7.notDeliveredStep1: Check your mailbox, porch, garage, and around your property
s7.notDeliveredStep2: Ask neighbors if the package was left with them
s7.notDeliveredStep3: Check with your building manager if you live in an apartment
s7.notDeliveredStep4: Wait 1 additional business day — carriers sometimes mark packages as delivered a day early
s7.notDeliveredStep5: If still not found, contact us via WhatsApp within 7 days of the reported delivery date. We will file a carrier claim on your behalf.
s7.damagedIntro: If your package arrives visibly damaged:
s7.damagedStep1: Take photos of the outer packaging (box/mailer) before opening if possible
s7.damagedStep2: Take photos of the damaged items inside
s7.damagedStep3: Contact us via WhatsApp within 48 hours of delivery with your photos and order number
s7.damagedStep4: Keep all packaging materials — carriers may need to inspect them for the claim
s7.damagedNote: We will work with the carrier to file a claim and will arrange a replacement or refund once the claim is reviewed.

s8.heading: Food Safety During Shipping
s8.body1: All products we sell are shelf-stable, non-perishable Indonesian pantry items (mie, bumbu, sambal, snack, kopi, etc.). They do not require refrigeration during transit.
s8.chocolateNote: Products containing chocolate (e.g., wafer bars, chocolate-coated snacks) may melt in extreme heat during summer months. We recommend selecting faster shipping options if ordering these items during hot weather. We are not responsible for heat-related melting during transit after the package is in the carrier's possession.
s8.storageNote: Store all products according to the instructions on their packaging once you receive your order
